jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch.

The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead.

Your role

Key responsibilities

-Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities.
-Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews.
-Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls.
-Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting).
-Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management.
-Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance.
-Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients.
-Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives.
-Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews.
-Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks.
-Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management.
-Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations.
-Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned.

Your profile

-Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business.
-Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework.
-Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role.
-6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations.
-Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous.
-Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills.

-Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
-Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders.
-Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra

Il gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Pictet è presente a Singapore da oltre 30 anni dove impiega oltre 200 persone.

La funzione Compliance è responsabile dell’aiuto alla gestione senior di Pictet a gestire i rischi di conformità affrontati da Pictet. Questo ruolo si concentrerà sui rischi affrontati dalla banca di Singapore di Pictet, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch.

L’AML/CFT Compliance Officer fa parte del team che supervisiona il quadro finanziario della Banca, incentrato principalmente sulla conformità di AML/CFT e sanzioni. L'incumbent esegue revisioni sistematiche AML/CFT su clienti ad alto rischio prima di salire a bordo e successive revisioni periodiche, recensioni avvisi/problemi aumentati da funzioni di prima linea e segnala sospetti di attività criminale o sanzionata, e fornisce consigli su AML/CFT e gestione delle sanzioni. L'ufficiale controlla i cambiamenti che possono influire sul business, lavorando con funzioni di business e supporto per garantire che la Banca sia conforme agli obblighi normativi e agli standard del Gruppo nell'area della criminalità finanziaria. Il ruolo si riferirà al Compliance AML Lead.

Il tuo ruolo

Responsabilità chiave

-Investire avvisi pertinenti e attività sospette, e eseguire il deposito di STR alle autorità locali.
-Perform ex-ante AML recensioni su client ad alto rischio onboarding e recensioni periodiche.
-Review avvisi escalated dal monitoraggio delle transazioni in prima linea, filtro dei pagamenti e controlli di screening dei nomi in corso.
-Le richieste esterne di sostegno includono ordini di produzione, domande di due diligence e qualsiasi segnalazione di regolamentazione rilevante (ad es. il reporting Remote Gambling Act).
-Agitare come consulente esperto per le funzioni aziendali e di supporto in materia di conformità e normative relative alla gestione delle sanzioni AML/CFT e internazionale.
-Performare un AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) annuale che identifica i rischi e le lacune quadro/controllo per l'attenzione della gestione e Gruppo -Compliance.
-Assista con progettazione periodica basata sul rischio e test di efficacia operativa dei controlli AML/CFT di prima linea, compresi i clienti a basso rischio.
-Represente Compliance come necessario per progetti e iniziative di criminalità finanziaria.
-Assista nella risoluzione dei piani di azione di gestione di proprietà di conformità da audit, ispezioni e recensioni di Gruppo.
-Produrre relazioni informative di gestione rilevanti a bordo e gestione senior sulla governance dei rischi di criminalità finanziaria.
-Costruire e mantenere un rapporto proattivo e costruttivo con gli stakeholder aziendali e funzionali per garantire controlli appropriati sono in atto per l'identificazione e la gestione del rischio di criminalità finanziaria.
- Tenere il passo e comprendere l'impatto delle nuove normative sulla criminalità finanziaria e, se necessario, rappresentare la Banca nelle consultazioni industriali.
- Sostenere il Singapore AML Lead su tutte le questioni AML/CFT e qualsiasi altro dovere come assegnato.

-La conoscenza delle tipologie CDSA, AML/CFT, dei regolamenti MAS rilevanti e dell'orientamento su AML/CFT e sul quadro delle sanzioni internazionali.

Dein Team

Die Pictet-Gruppe ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Pictet ist seit mehr als 30 Jahren in Singapur präsent und beschäftigt dort über 200 Mitarbeiter.

Die Compliance-Funktion ist dafür verantwortlich, die Geschäftsleitung von Pictet bei der Steuerung der Compliance-Risiken zu unterstützen, denen Pictet ausgesetzt ist. Diese Rolle wird sich auf die Risiken der Pictet-Bank in Singapur, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch, konzentrieren.

Der AML/CFT Compliance Officer ist Teil des Teams, das den Finanzkriminalitätsrahmen der Bank überwacht, der sich hauptsächlich auf die Einhaltung von AML/CFT und Sanktionen konzentriert. Der etablierte Betreiber führt systematische AML / CFT-Überprüfungen bei Kunden mit hohem Risiko vor dem Onboarding und anschließende regelmäßige Überprüfungen durch, überprüft Warnungen / Probleme, die durch Erstlinienfunktionen eskaliert wurden, und meldet Verdacht auf kriminelle oder sanktionierte Aktivitäten und berät Sie zum AML / CFT- und Sanktionsmanagement. Der leitende Angestellte überwacht Änderungen, die sich auf das Geschäft auswirken können, und arbeitet mit Geschäfts- und Unterstützungsfunktionen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Bank die regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Gruppenstandards im Bereich der Finanzkriminalität einhält. Die Rolle wird an den Compliance AML Lead berichten.

Deine Rolle

Hauptzuständigkeiten

-Untersuchen Sie relevante Warnungen und verdächtige Aktivitäten und führen Sie die Einreichung von STR an lokale Behörden durch.
Führen Sie Ex-ante-AML-Bewertungen zum Onboarding von Kunden mit hohem Risiko und regelmäßige Überprüfungen durch.
-Überprüfung eskalierter Warnmeldungen aus der First-Line-Transaktionsüberwachung, Zahlungsfilterung und laufenden Kontrolle der Namensüberprüfung.
Support externe Anfragen umfassen Produktionsaufträge, Due Diligence Anfragen und alle relevanten regulatorischen Berichte (z. B. Remote Gambling Act Reporting).
Als fachkundiger Berater für Geschäfts- und Supportfunktionen in Compliance- und Regulierungsfragen im Zusammenhang mit AML / CFT und internationalem Sanktionsmanagement fungieren.
Führen Sie eine jährliche AML / CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) durch, um Risiken und Rahmen- / Kontrolllücken für das Management und die Gruppen-Compliance zu identifizieren.
Unterstützung bei regelmäßigen risikobasierten Design- und Betriebseffektivitätstests von First-Line-AML/CFT-Kontrollen, einschließlich bei Kunden mit geringerem Risiko.
-Repräsentieren Sie bei Bedarf Compliance bei Projekten und Initiativen im Zusammenhang mit Finanzkriminalität.
Unterstützung bei der Lösung von Compliance-eigenen Management-Aktionsplänen aus Audits, Inspektionen und Gruppenbewertungen.
Erstellung relevanter Management-Informationsberichte an Vorstand und Geschäftsleitung zur Steuerung von Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken.
Aufbau und Pflege einer proaktiven und konstruktiven Beziehung zu Unternehmen und funktionalen Stakeholdern, um sicherzustellen, dass angemessene Kontrollen für die Identifizierung und das Management von Finanzkriminalitätsrisiken vorhanden sind.
-Halten Sie sich auf dem Laufenden und verstehen Sie die Auswirkungen neuer Vorschriften für Finanzkriminalität und vertreten Sie die Bank bei Bedarf in Branchenberatungen.
Unterstützen Sie den Singapur AML Lead in allen AML / CFT-Angelegenheiten und allen anderen zugewiesenen Aufgaben.

Dein Profil

Bachelor-Abschluss in Law, Banking oder Business.
Kenntnisse der CDSA, der AML/CFT-Typologien, der einschlägigen MAS-Verordnungen und der Leitlinien für AML/CFT und des internationalen Sanktionsrahmens.
-Arbeitserfahrung in Singapur Regulierungslandschaft und Erwartungen erforderlich. Vertrautheit mit Vorschriften und Leitlinien in einer AML, Financial Crime Compliance Rolle.
-6-10 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Einhaltung von AML/CFT, insbesondere bei Untersuchungen.
-Vorherige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einer Privatbank wird von Vorteil sein.
-Hochwirksame verbale und schriftliche Kommunikation und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.

Fähigkeit, konkurrierende Prioritäten mit mehreren Aufgaben zu bearbeiten und gleichzeitig ein hohes Maß an Genauigkeit und Aufmerksamkeit für Details beizubehalten.
-Fähig zur Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden und leitenden Stakeholdern.
-Gefühl der Rechenschaftspflicht, gutes Zeitmanagement und Fähigkeit, enge Fristen einzuhalten.

Votre équipe

Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux des gestionnaires de patrimoine et d'actifs indépendants. Pictet est présent à Singapour depuis plus de 30 ans où il emploie plus de 200 personnes.

La fonction Conformité est chargée d'aider la haute direction de Pictet à gérer les risques de conformité auxquels elle fait face. Ce rôle sera axé sur les risques auxquels est confrontée la banque de Singapour Pictet, la Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) la succursale de Singapour.

L'agent de conformité de la LMA/FT fait partie de l'équipe qui supervise le cadre de criminalité financière de la Banque, principalement axé sur la LMA/FT et le respect des sanctions. Le titulaire effectue des examens systématiques de la LMA/FT sur les clients à risque élevé avant de s'embarquer et les examens périodiques subséquents, examine les alertes/questions aggravées par les fonctions de première ligne et signale les soupçons d'activités criminelles ou sanctionnées, et fournit des conseils sur la LMA/FT et la gestion des sanctions. L'agent surveille les changements qui peuvent avoir une incidence sur l'entreprise, en travaillant avec les fonctions d'affaires et de soutien pour s'assurer que la Banque respecte les obligations réglementaires et les normes du Groupe dans le domaine de la criminalité financière. Le rôle relèvera du responsable de la LMA de la conformité.

Votre rôle

Principales responsabilités

-Inspecter les alertes pertinentes et les activités suspectes, et effectuer le dépôt de la DOD auprès des autorités locales.
- Effectuer des examens ex ante de la LMA sur les clients à risque élevé à bord et des examens périodiques.
-L'examen a augmenté les alertes provenant de la surveillance des transactions de première ligne, du filtrage des paiements et des contrôles permanents de contrôle des noms.
-Soutenir les demandes externes, notamment les ordonnances de production, les demandes de diligence raisonnable et tout rapport réglementaire pertinent (p. ex. la Loi sur le jeu à distance).
-Faire office de conseiller expert auprès des entreprises et des fonctions de soutien sur les questions de conformité et de réglementation liées à la LMA/FT et à la gestion des sanctions internationales.
- Effectuer une évaluation annuelle des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise (EWRA) de la LMA/FT, qui identifie les risques et le cadre ou les lacunes de contrôle à l'attention de la direction et du Groupe - Conformité.
-Assister à la conception périodique fondée sur le risque et à l'évaluation de l'efficacité opérationnelle des contrôles de première ligne de LBA/FT, y compris sur les clients à faible risque.
-Représenter la conformité au besoin sur les projets et initiatives liés à la criminalité financière.
-Assister à la résolution des plans d'action de gestion de la conformité des audits, inspections et examens de groupe.
- Produire des rapports d'information de gestion pertinents au conseil d'administration et à la haute direction sur la gouvernance des risques de criminalité financière.
-Construire et maintenir des relations proactives et constructives avec les intervenants opérationnels et fonctionnels afin de s'assurer que des contrôles appropriés sont en place pour identifier et gérer les risques de criminalité financière.
-Tenir au courant et comprendre l'impact des nouveaux règlements sur la criminalité financière et, au besoin, représenter la Banque dans les consultations de l'industrie.
- Appuyer la direction de la LMA de Singapour sur toutes les questions relatives à la LMA/FT et sur toutes les autres tâches qui lui sont assignées.

Votre profil

- Baccalauréat en droit, banque ou affaires.
-Connaissance de la CDSA, des typologies AML/CFT, des règlements pertinents du MAS et des directives sur la LAM/CFT et le cadre international des sanctions.
- Expérience de travail du paysage réglementaire de Singapour et attentes nécessaires. Connaissance des règlements et des directives dans le cadre d'une LMA, Crime financier Rôle de conformité.
-6-10 ans d'expérience pertinente en matière de conformité à la LAM/FT, en particulier en ce qui concerne les enquêtes.
-Une expérience antérieure dans un rôle similaire dans une banque privée sera avantageuse.

-Capacité à plusieurs tâches prioritaires concurrentes tout en maintenant un degré élevé de précision et d'attention aux détails.
-Capacité de travailler avec les parties prenantes interfonctionnelles et supérieures.
-Responsabilité, bonne gestion du temps et capacité à respecter des délais serrés.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies.

Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:

• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.

• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.

• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.

• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.

• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.

• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.

• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.

• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.

• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF).

Your profile

• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.

• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.

• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.

• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business.

As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.

You will be part of a team of 20 professionals dedicated to Pictet’s pan-European Direct Real Estate franchise, which began in 2019 with the launch of Elevation Fund I, a EUR 700 million value-add fund. Elevation Fund II was launched in 2023, and a Core Plus fund, with approximately EUR 200 million under management, was launched in 2021. The team is distributed across several locations: in London, where the core investment and asset management teams are based; in Geneva, where the investment legal and investor relations teams operate; and in Berlin, Stockholm, and Madrid, where our regional heads are located. Additionally, fund support functions such as fund administration, compliance, and legal affairs are situated in Luxembourg.

Based in Geneva or London, you will work closely with the Senior Legal Advisor covering the Direct Real Estate activity to support the activity during the maternity leave of our Legal Advisor.

Your role

• Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of real estate and financing documents, including shareholders’ agreements, financing agreements, lease agreements, SPAs, construction agreements, etc.

• Support direct real estate transactions from inception to closing, helping to drive execution by coordinating legal workstreams, managing negotiations and liaising with internal stakeholders and external advisers.

• Act as a key legal partner on cross-border matters, working closely with internal teams across jurisdictions on transaction status, documentation, payment mechanics and related execution steps. It would be important to evidence having led transactions in at least 3 different jurisdictions.

• Provide day-to-day legal support on asset management and project matters, combining strong technical legal drafting with a practical, solutions-oriented approach to business issues. Business oriented mindset finding solutions to our team’s problems instead of acting only as a gatekeeper.

• Lead and support legal documentation for development, construction and refurbishment matters, including preparing, revising and finalising project and works contracts for counterparties.

Your profile

• At least 5 years’ experience (post-qualification) in the real estate department of a major and reputable law firm.

• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.

• A strong interest in and/or experience with AI would be an asset.

• Fluency in English is a must, French, Spanish, German or Danish would be an asset.

• The role can be located in London or in Geneva.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La tua squadra Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) è uno specialista di investimento alternativo leader e interamente controllata del Gruppo Pictet, con competenze in fondi di copertura, private equity e immobili globali. Con i team di tutto il mondo, i team PAA costruiscono, gestiscono e consigliano portafogli di soluzioni di investimento alternative per clienti istituzionali e privati. Sarete parte di un team di 20 professionisti dedicati al franchise paneuropeo Direct Real Estate di Pictet, iniziato nel 2019 con il lancio di Elevation Fund I, un fondo di valore di 700 milioni di euro. Elevation Fund II è stato lanciato nel 2023, e un fondo Core Plus, con circa 200 milioni di euro sotto la gestione, è stato lanciato nel 2021. Il team è distribuito in diverse sedi: a Londra, dove si basano i principali team di investimento e asset management; a Ginevra, dove operano i team di investimento legali e di relazioni con gli investitori; e a Berlino, Stoccolma e Madrid, dove si trovano i nostri capi regionali. Inoltre, le funzioni di sostegno dei fondi come l'amministrazione dei fondi, la conformità e le questioni legali sono situate in Lussemburgo. Con sede a Ginevra o a Londra, lavorerai a stretto contatto con il Senior Legal Advisor che copre l'attività di Direct Real Estate per sostenere l'attività durante il congedo di maternità del nostro Legal Advisor. Il tuo ruolo
• Guidare la revisione, la redazione e la negoziazione di una vasta gamma di documenti immobiliari e finanziari, compresi gli accordi degli azionisti, accordi di finanziamento, accordi di locazione, SPA, accordi di costruzione, ecc.
• Sostenere le transazioni immobiliari dirette dall'inizio alla chiusura, contribuendo a guidare l'esecuzione coordinando i flussi di lavoro legali, gestendo i negoziati e liaising con gli stakeholder interni e i consulenti esterni.
• Agire come partner legale chiave in materia transfrontaliera, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team interni di tutte le giurisdizioni sullo stato delle transazioni, la documentazione, la meccanica dei pagamenti e le relative fasi di esecuzione. Sarebbe importante dimostrare di aver condotto transazioni in almeno 3 diverse giurisdizioni.
• Fornire assistenza legale quotidiana in materia di asset management e di progetto, combinando una forte stesura legale tecnica con un approccio pratico e orientato alle soluzioni alle questioni aziendali. La mentalità orientata agli affari trova soluzioni ai problemi del nostro team invece di agire solo come portiere.
• Guidare e sostenere la documentazione legale per le questioni di sviluppo, costruzione e ristrutturazione, tra cui la preparazione, la revisione e la finalizzazione dei progetti e dei contratti di lavoro per le controparti. Il tuo profilo
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza (post-qualifica) nel reparto immobiliare di uno studio legale importante e rispettabile.
• Rigoroso, con ottime capacità di numerazione e un'attenta attenzione ai dettagli.
• Un forte interesse per e/o esperienza con l'AI sarebbe un bene.
• La fluenza in inglese è un must, francese, spagnolo, tedesco o danese sarebbe un bene.
• Il ruolo può essere situato a Londra o a Ginevra. Nota Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie Diversità e inclusione Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Dein Team Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) ist ein führender Spezialist für alternative Anlagen und eine hundertprozentige Tochtergesellschaft der Pictet-Gruppe mit Expertise in den Bereichen Hedgefonds, Private Equity und globale Immobilien. Mit Teams auf der ganzen Welt konstruieren, verwalten und beraten die PAA-Teams Portfolios alternativer Anlagelösungen für institutionelle und private Kunden. Sie werden Teil eines Teams von 20 Fachleuten sein, das sich dem paneuropäischen Direct Real Estate-Franchise von Pictet widmet, das 2019 mit der Einführung des Elevation Fund I begann, einem Wertschöpfungsfonds in Höhe von 700 Millionen Euro. Der Elevation Fund II wurde 2023 aufgelegt, und 2021 wurde ein Core Plus-Fonds mit rund 200 Mio. EUR verwaltet. Das Team ist auf mehrere Standorte verteilt: in London, wo die Kernteams für Investment und Asset Management ansässig sind; in Genf, wo die Teams für Investment Legal und Investor Relations tätig sind; und in Berlin, Stockholm und Madrid, wo unsere regionalen Leiter angesiedelt sind. Darüber hinaus sind Fondsunterstützungsfunktionen wie Fondsverwaltung, Compliance und rechtliche Angelegenheiten in Luxemburg angesiedelt. Mit Sitz in Genf oder London arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Senior Legal Advisor zusammen, der die Direct Real Estate-Aktivität abdeckt, um die Aktivität während des Mutterschaftsurlaubs unseres Legal Advisors zu unterstützen. Deine Rolle
• Führen Sie die Überprüfung, Ausarbeitung und Verhandlung einer breiten Palette von Immobilien- und Finanzierungsdokumenten, einschließlich Aktionärsvereinbarungen, Finanzierungsvereinbarungen, Mietverträgen, SPAs, Bauverträgen usw.
• Unterstützung von direkten Immobilientransaktionen von der Gründung bis zum Abschluss und Unterstützung der Ausführung durch die Koordination von rechtlichen Workstreams, die Verwaltung von Verhandlungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Beratern.
• Handeln Sie als wichtiger Rechtspartner in grenzüberschreitenden Angelegenheiten und arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Teams in allen Jurisdiktionen in Bezug auf Transaktionsstatus, Dokumentation, Zahlungsmechanismen und damit verbundene Ausführungsschritte zusammen. Es wäre wichtig, nachzuweisen, dass Transaktionen in mindestens 3 verschiedenen Gerichtsbarkeiten durchgeführt wurden.
• Gewährleistung der täglichen rechtlichen Unterstützung bei Vermögensverwaltungs- und Projektangelegenheiten, wobei eine solide technische Rechtsgestaltung mit einem praktischen, lösungsorientierten Ansatz für Geschäftsfragen kombiniert wird. Business-orientierte Denkweise, Lösungen für die Probleme unseres Teams zu finden, anstatt nur als Gatekeeper zu handeln.
• Leitung und Unterstützung der rechtlichen Dokumentation für Entwicklungs-, Bau- und Sanierungsangelegenheiten, einschließlich Vorbereitung, Überarbeitung und Abschluss von Projekt- und Bauverträgen für Vertragspartner. Dein Profil
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung (Nachqualifizierung) in der Immobilienabteilung einer großen und renommierten Anwaltskanzlei.
• Streng, mit ausgezeichneten Rechenfähigkeiten und einer scharfen Liebe zum Detail.
• Ein starkes Interesse an und / oder Erfahrung mit KI wäre ein Vorteil.
• fließend Englisch ist ein Muss, Französisch, Spanisch, Deutsch oder Dänisch wäre ein Gewinn.
• Die Rolle kann in London oder in Genf angesiedelt sein. Avec des équipes basées dans le monde entier, les équipes de l'AAP construisent, gèrent et conseillent des portefeuilles de solutions d'investissement alternatives pour les clients institutionnels et privés. L'équipe est répartie sur plusieurs sites : à Londres, où se trouvent les principales équipes de gestion des investissements et des actifs, à Genève, où opèrent les équipes de relations juridiques et d'investissement et à Berlin, Stockholm et Madrid, où se trouvent nos chefs régionaux. En outre, les fonctions de soutien des fonds, telles que l'administration des fonds, la conformité et les affaires juridiques, sont situées à Luxembourg. Basé à Genève ou Londres, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le conseiller juridique principal chargé de l'activité Immobilier Direct pour soutenir l'activité pendant le congé de maternité de notre conseiller juridique. • Diriger l'examen, la rédaction et la négociation d'un large éventail de documents immobiliers et financiers, y compris les accords d'actionnaires, les accords de financement, les contrats de location, les accords de location, les accords de construction, etc.
• Soutenir les transactions immobilières directes depuis le début jusqu'à la clôture, contribuer à l'exécution en coordonnant les flux de travail juridiques, en gérant les négociations et en assurant la liaison avec les acteurs internes et les conseillers externes.
• Agir en tant que partenaire juridique clé sur les questions transfrontalières, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes des différents pays sur l'état des transactions, la documentation, les mécanismes de paiement et les étapes d'exécution connexes. Il serait important de prouver avoir mené des opérations dans au moins trois juridictions différentes.
• Fournir un appui juridique quotidien en matière de gestion des actifs et de projets, en combinant une solide rédaction juridique technique avec une approche pratique et axée sur les solutions des questions d'affaires. L'esprit d'entreprise trouver des solutions aux problèmes de notre équipe au lieu d'agir comme un gardien de porte.
• Diriger et soutenir la documentation juridique pour les questions de développement, de construction et de rénovation, y compris la préparation, la révision et la finalisation des contrats de projet et de travaux pour les contreparties. Votre profil
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience (post-qualification) dans le département immobilier d'un cabinet d'avocats majeur et réputé.
• Rigieuse, avec d'excellentes compétences en calcul et une attention particulière au détail.
• Un fort intérêt pour l'IA et/ou l'expérience de celle-ci serait un atout.
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est un must, français, espagnol, allemand ou danois serait un atout.
• Le rôle peut être situé à Londres ou à Genève. jobs.description:
Your team

Business Compliace Manager

The successful candidate will join a team whose principal function is to analyse and perform control activities related to anti-money laundering (AML) and business risks.

Your role

The function will, amongst other tasks, assist the Chief Risk Officer & MLRO with:

• Promoting a strong compliance culture within the Bank.

• Reviewing new account applications for compliance with KYC requirements.

• Completing risk ratings of new accounts.

• Periodic reviews of existing customer accounts.

• Identification and review of unusual transactions.

• Review and analysis of name screening alerts.

• Reporting of key performamce indicators.

Your profile

• Strong analytical skills.

• Ability to work independently and under pressure to meet strict deadlines.

• Must be a team player.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.

• Excellent research and analytical skills.

• Proficiency in a variety of software applications including Microsoft Office.

• At least five (5) years compliance or audit experience in a Private Bank or Trust Company.

• University degree (Banking, Finance, Law, Business Administration or a related field).

• Professional qualification (ICA International Compliance and Anti-Money Laundering Diplomas or ACAMS Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Certification).

• Experience in the preparation of information reports.

• In-depth knowledge of The Bank & Trust Companies Regulation Act, 2020.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Trading & Sales (PTS) provides direct access to global markets, offering bespoke trading solutions across a wide range of asset classes. Our teams of sales traders, IT specialists, strategists and quant analysts are assisted by a full suite of risk and control functions as well as the latest technology.

At the core of PTS derivatives activity, as part of the Middle Office – Derivatives team, you will own the integrity and performance of ETD, OTC, and structured products operations. You will ensure trades and lifecycle events flow accurately and efficiently and solve complex operational problems. Beyond daily operations, you will help drive automation and redesign workflows to build a more scalable, resilient, and high-performing operating model.

Your role

• Own the day-to-day integrity of derivatives operations across ETD and OTC products, ensuring accurate booking follow-up and robust lifecycle management.

• Investigate and resolve booking, lifecycle, and reconciliation issues; identify root causes and contribute to permanent, scalable solutions.

• Act as a key operational partner to Trading Desks (Agency and Principal Trading), providing timely and reliable support on trade-related matters.

• Maintaining a high-quality service with internal entities as PTS, PWM, PAS, POI and Operations.

• Contribute to the automation, standardization, and optimization of operational workflows.

Your profile

• 3/5 years professional experience with ETD and OTC asset classes, including structured products.

• Excellent knowledge of ETD and OTC asset classes and good knowledge of banking industry.

• Ability to prioritize effectively and adapt in a fast-paced trading environment.

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Comfortable operating under pressure in a dynamic trading-floor environment

• Proven interest in process improvement, automation, and leveraging data and AI-driven solutions to enhance operational efficiency and scalability

• Knowledge of Front Arena, Bloomberg, Avaloq or Lexifi is considered an asset.

• Fluent in English, a second language is a plus.

• Swiss residency or willing to relocate.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the center of derivatives activity within PTS, combining operational ownership, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. You will gain broad exposure across ETD, OTC, and structured products while contributing to the evolution of a more automated, efficient, and scalable operating model in close interaction with the trading floor.

Start date: ASAP

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

As part of the Client Register team , you will contribute to the management and integrity of client data, supporting the bank’s core operations and ensuring a high standard of service for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams, without direct contact with clients.

Your main responsibilities will include managing the opening and closing of customer accounts for the bank and its branches, as well as handling credit card administration for customers. This involves updating static data and the services selected by our clients and performing “Cotation” tasks such as signature verification.

In addition, you will play a central role in the transformation of our activities by driving the identification, implementation, and optimization of automation and digitalization solutions for our processes. You will ensure strict adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements, while supporting the various business lines of the Bank.

Your role

• Play a key role in managing client account openings and updates for individuals, legal entities, and trusts, ensuring a seamless client experience.

• Strive for excellence in data quality and completeness, supporting both business growth and regulatory requirements.

• Take charge of credit card administration, working closely with service providers to deliver efficient solutions.

• Perform analysis of account structures and verification of client signatures to ensure the validity and compliance of payment instructions.

• Make a real impact by contributing to data remediation initiatives and maintaining accurate client records.

• Be proactive in improving departmental procedures, keeping us aligned with the latest industry standards.

• Embrace digital transformation by supporting the adoption of automation and AI solutions.

• Foster consistency and efficiency by promoting process harmonization across the Group.

• Get involved in projects that drive innovation and enhance client data management.

• Collaborate with dedicated colleagues and key stakeholders across the business.

• Be a valued partner, responding to requests from all business lines regarding Client Register activities.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree, ideally complemented by initial experience in the banking sector (Operations)

Soft skills:

• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.

• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.

• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

• Discreet and able to handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism.

Technical skills:

• Proficient in standard MS Office products.

• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset.

Language skills:

• Fluent in written and spoken French. Good command of English. German is an asset.

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

We are an independent investment partnership known for our long-term mindset, responsible approach to business, and entrepreneurial spirit. These principles have defined us since 1805. For our clients, colleagues and wider society, we always aim to do the right thing and honour our commitment to enduring quality.

Pictet opened its Tokyo office in 1981 to conduct research on the Japanese economy and equity market. It began providing asset management services to institutional investors in 1987 and entered the investment trust (mutual fund) business in 1997. As of the end of March 2026, the firm’s assets under management totaled 4.56 trillion yen.

Your role

We are seeking an economist to lead our global research and analysis on macroeconomics, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange.

Key responsibilities include preparing reports and presentation materials on macroeconomic and financial market developments; delivering presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media; and providing clear explanations and interpretive support during client meetings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills and excellent communication abilities, with the proven ability to convey complex information effectively in both English and Japanese.

Responsibilities

• Conduct in-depth analysis of macroeconomic trends, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange in Japan and globally

• Prepare reports and presentation materials for both internal and external stakeholders

• Deliver presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media

• Provide clear explanations and interpretation support during client meetings

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as an economist

• Deep understanding of macroeconomics and financial markets

• Native-level proficiency in Japanese and business-level or higher proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Excellent report writing and presentation skills

• Demonstrated experience in client-facing roles

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Certified Member Analyst of the Securities Analysts Association of Japan (CMA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)

• Bloomberg

Main location : Tokyo office, Marunouchi, Chiyoda‑ku ( must be a resident in Japan with work permit )

• Manage facility services and maintenance, including lighting, electrical systems, cleaning, workplace reconfigurations, fire safety, and asset inventory.

• Minimum 2–3 years of experience in system administration and end-user support.

• Excellent troubleshooting abilities

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

The Technical Business Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, supporting the Funds Platform with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes. The role is responsible for understanding, analyzing, and translating business needs into effective technical solutions, ensuring the continuous improvement of business analysis practices and contributing to the overall success of the platform within the funds industry.

Your role

• Collaborate with business subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for the funds platform, with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes and operations.

• Translate business needs into clear, actionable IT requirements, user stories, and test scenarios using Agile methodologies and Jira.

• Propose and evaluate solution options in coordination with solution architects, considering existing systems, software, and market innovations (including AI).

• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including specifications, process flows, and user guides.

• Lead project management activities as necessary, including stakeholder coordination, meeting facilitation, and milestone tracking.

• Conduct data analysis and support data-driven decision-making.

• Ensure the execution and delivery of IT projects in line with business requirements, timelines, and quality standards.

• Carry out functional acceptance testing, analyze production incidents, and support users during and after implementation.

• Contribute to process improvement initiatives by designing and implementing efficient workflows during system changes or migrations, focusing on innovation and optimization over replication of legacy processes

• Actively participate as a member of the Business Analyst Chapter; s hare knowledge, best practices, and drive the evolution of the business analysis discipline within the chapter

Your profile

• Min 5 years experience in a bank as Business Analyst

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in the funds industry, with a strong focus on transfer agency processes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to facilitate meetings and workshops.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a dynamic environment

• Project management experience, including organizing and leading cross-functional meetings.

• Fluent in English, French is an asset

• In-depth knowledge of transfer agency functions, including investor servicing, transaction processing, and related regulatory requirements.

• Experience with industry platforms and tools relevant to transfer agency (e.g., Multifonds TA, Fenergo); experience with system integrations and data migrations is a plus.

• Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and troubleshooting

• Experience working in Agile environments, with hands-on use of JIRA (and Confluence) for story management and project tracking.

• Ability to write clear, structured documentation and user stories.

• Familiarity with AI tools and their application in business analysis; experience implementing AI-driven solutions is a plus.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

• Vorschlagen und Bewerten von Lösungsoptionen in Abstimmung mit Lösungsarchitekten unter Berücksichtigung bestehender Systeme, Software und Marktinnovationen (einschließlich KI).

• Führen Sie bei Bedarf Projektmanagement-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Stakeholder-Koordinierung, Besprechungserleichterungen und Meilenstein-Tracking.

• Datenanalyse durchführen und datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen.

• Sicherstellung der Durchführung und Bereitstellung von IT-Projekten in Übereinstimmung mit Geschäftsanforderungen, Zeitplänen und Qualitätsstandards.

• Durchführung von funktionalen Akzeptanztests, Analyse von Produktionsvorfällen und Unterstützung der Benutzer während und nach der Implementierung.

• Min. 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Bank als Business Analyst

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung als Business Analyst oder Technical Business Analyst in der Fondsbranche mit einem starken Fokus auf Transferagenturprozesse.

• Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments.

The Corporate Compliance Officer participates in monitoring the company's activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and also takes part in the implementation of the CMP (Control Monitoring Plan). He also ensures the strengthening of the company's procedural and training framework.

Your role

• Analyze regulatory watch screenings performing gap analysis on new regulations and assess their potential impact within the company.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of the Compliance Monitoring Plan by identifying applicable compliance standards and monitoring controls using a risk-based approach.

• Identify and assess compliance risks to which the company is exposed, make appropriate observations, and verify appropriate follow up on related to identified issues with the different stakeholders.

• Assist in establishing and maintaining a compliance manual, ensuring that all internal policies and procedures comply with legal requirements and group minimum standards.

• Assist in the training of new employees on compliance topics and ensure that compliance training is conducted at defined intervals.

• Participate in regulatory projects by providing advice on legal requirements and ensuring that delivered solutions comply with regulations and minimum group standards.

• Maintain and update various registers, including investor complaints, conflicts of interest, personal transactions, gifts, and identified issues.

• Follow up on audit recommendations and participate in the proper implementation.

• Collaborate with regulators and the Ministry of Finance to ensure compliance and respond to regulatory requests.

Your profile

Request experience:

• Bachelor or Master degree in compliance, legal or related field.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a equivalent role.

Technical skills:

• Good knowledge of European and Luxembourgish regulations.

• Understanding of the operational mechanisms of a management company and the associated regulatory framework.

• Good knowledge of the industry of Fund and Asset Management.

• Ability to perform controls. Former experience on audit (external or internal) is a plus.

• Written and oral communication skills.

Soft skills:

• Discretion, rigor, and reliability.

• Analytical skills and critical thinking.

• Good organizational and priority management skills.

• Ability to navigate complex and constantly evolving environments

Language skills:

• French: fluent

• English: fluent

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
